Title: Azure Database for MySQL—Large storage is now generally available

Body.Content:
Support is now available for up to 16 TB of storage and up to 20,000 IOPS in Azure Database services for MySQL. With this functionality, you not only get five times more storage for database servers, but also more than triple the available IOPS. This ensures that you can run your most demanding, large scale workloads on Azure Database services for MySQL.

Learn more in the related service detail.
